Name: Esca's Modding Plugins (EMP)
Author: EscaMMC
Description:
[b]Esca's Modding Plugins (EMP)[/b] adds miscellaneous new features for other mods to use. Mods can control these features by editing EMP's data assets, using new map/tile properties, etc.
[line]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. [b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/b]
2. [b]Download EMP[/b] from the Files tab, the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/EscasModdingPlugins/releases]GitHub releases page[/url], or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1005443-escas-modding-plugins-emp]ModDrop[/url].
3. [b]Unzip EMP[/b] into the [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.

If you have other mods that require EMP, then you're all set!

If you want to use EMP features in your own mods, then see the instructions below.

[b]Multiplayer note[/b]: All players should install this mod for multiplayer sessions.
[line]
[size=4][b]Features for Players[/b][/size]

EMP lets players enable some of its features as "quality of life" changes for personal use:

[b]Place beds anywhere:[/b] If enabled, you can place beds at any location.
[b]Place mini-fridges anywhere:[/b] If enabled, you can place mini-fridges at any location.
[b]Pass out safely anywhere:[/b] If enabled, you won't lose money if you pass out by staying awake too late (2:00 AM). NOTE: This doesn't change what happens if you run out of health.

To edit these options:

1. [b]Run the game[/b] using SMAPI. This will generate the mod's [b]config.json[/b] file in the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods\EscasModdingPlugins[/i] folder.
2. [b]Exit the game[/b] and open the [b]config.json[/b] file with any text editing program.

This mod also supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].
[line]
[size=4][b]Features for Modders[/b][/size]

For information about using these features in your mods, see the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/EscasModdingPlugins]GitHub readme[/url] and [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/EscasModdingPlugins/blob/master/docs/emp-modding-guide.md]EMP Modding Guide[/url].

EMP lets other mods control these game mechanics:

[b]Bed Placement:[/b] Allow players to place moveable (furniture) beds at a location. Also includes an option to prevent money loss and NPC "rescue" letters if players run out of stamina at a location.
[b]Custom Order Boards:[/b] Create new Special Orders boards that only display orders from a custom category. (See the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Special_orders]Data/SpecialOrders[/url] asset.)
* Custom Order Boards were commissioned by Lumina/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844?tab=about+me]Lumisteria[/url]!
[b]Destroyable Bushes:[/b] Mark bushes as destroyable at specific locations and/or tiles, allowing players to remove them with any upgraded axe.
[b]Fish Locations:[/b] Give locations multiple "zones" with different fish, including fish from other locations. (See the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Location_data]Data/Locations[/url] asset.)
[b]Kitchen Features:[/b] Allow players to open the cooking menu at non-farmhouse locations, similar to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Maps#Tile_properties_2]Action kitchen[/url]. Also includes an option to allow players to place [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Mini-Fridge]Mini-Fridges[/url].
[b]Water Color:[/b] Change the color of all water at a location.

EMP also adds these modding utilities for general use:

[b]Console Commands:[/b] Adds new SMAPI console commands, e.g. to help test mods.
[b]Content Patcher Tokens:[/b] Adds new tokens to Content Patcher, such as a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Game_state_queries]Game State Query[/url] token.
[b]Game State Queries:[/b] Adds new [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Game_state_queries]game state queries[/url] (GSQs) to Stardew's "condition" fields.
[b]Trigger Actions:[/b] Adds new [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Trigger_actions]trigger actions[/url] and triggers to [i]Data/TriggerActions[/i] and related fields.

[line]
[b][size=4]Translation[/size][/b]

EMP supports translation of its GMCM setting names and descriptions, as well as its SMAPI console commands.

The mod will load a file from the [i]EscasModdingPlugins/i18n[/i] folder that matches the current language code. If no matching translation exists, it will use [i]default.json[/i].

See the Stardew Valley Wiki's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations[/url] page for more information. Please feel free to submit translation files by linking them in a comment, submitting a GitHub pull request, or any other method.

The mod currently includes these translations:
